tlg_checks.needle: φρονήσατε περὶ τοῦ κυρίου ἐν ἀγαθότητι
ἐδόθη αὐτοῖς ἐκ πέτρας ἀκροτόμου ὕδωρ
δικαίως γὰρ ἔπασχον ταῖς ἰδίαις αὐτῶν πονηρίαις

edition_statement: The Old Testament in Greek, ed. Henry Barclay Swete, vol. 2, Cambridge University Press, 1896 (First1KGreek digitization, tlg0527.tlg033.1st1K-grc1, CC BY-SA 4.0)
issues: Chapter numbering error in the First1KGreek XML: no div n='15'; divs n='16'..'20' actually contain canonical Wisdom 15-19 (verified: div 16 v.1 = 'Σὺ δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν χρηστὸς καὶ ἀληθής' = Wis 15:1). canonical_ref uses corrected canonical numbering; cts_urn loci keep the edition's own (mislabeled) chapter numbers so they resolve against the digital edition.

Lacuna in chapter 3 of the digitization: verses 3:4b-3:17a are absent (one printed page lost in OCR); verse div n='4' conflates Wis 3:4a with Wis 3:17b. Staged as a single passage 'Wis. 3.1-19' containing only the extant text (390 chars). No text was supplied to fill the gap.

OCR quality of the Swete digitization is imperfect: scattered character errors preserved verbatim per zero-fabrication policy (e.g. 'σκολοὶ' for σκολιοὶ at 1:3, 'ἐποίγῳεν' for ἐποίησεν at 1:13, 'χελέων' for χειλέων at 1:6, 'καταχρἐῳ' for καταχρέῳ at 1:4).

Stripped non-textual artifacts only: TEI apparatus/marginal notes, page breaks, leaked verse-number digits/superscripts ((⁶), (¹³), 8, §24, ⁴⁷⁸), MS sigla (B/C), pilcrows, asterisk, pipe. No Greek letters altered or added.
Verse 1:6 OCR runs two verses together ('αὐτοῦὅτι'); preserved verbatim.
